recentItems.title: Selling Fantasy in Small-Town Britain | Rule Britannia
recentItems.description:
From the heyday of telephone chat lines to suburban dominatrixes and online adult entertainment, Britain’s adult entertainment industry exists far beyond the glamorous world of OnlyFans millionaires.

In Call Me, VICE meets three women in Wales whose lives have intersected with different corners of the adult industry. Through intimate portraits, they reflect on their experiences of money, intimacy, relationships and the business of selling fantasy.

Away from the glossy online success stories, the film explores the intersection of the sex industry and ordinary British life.

recentItems.title: Hells Angels vs. Mongols: Inside America’s Deadliest Biker Gang Rivalry | Hells Angels: At War
recentItems.description:
The Hells Angels and Mongols Motorcycle Club have spent decades locked in one of America's most violent outlaw biker rivalries. From deadly shootings in Colorado to the infamous 2002 Laughlin River Run casino brawl, their battle for territory, power and respect has left a trail of bloodshed across the country.

In this episode of Hells Angels: At War, former motorcycle club members, investigators and ATF agents reveal how the Mongols rose to challenge the Hells Angels' dominance. The documentary explores the origins of the Mongols MC, the deadly Laughlin casino shootout, the rise of Mongols leader Ruben "Doc" Cavazos and Operation Black Biscuit, an undercover ATF investigation that infiltrated the Hells Angels. As federal pressure mounts and biker gang alliances shift, the Mongols' expansion brings them into conflict with another powerful organization: the Mexican Mafia.

Hells Angels: At War explores the violent history of outlaw motorcycle clubs, the rivalries that shaped America's biker underworld and the law enforcement operations that brought their activities into the national spotlight.
#HellsAngels #MongolsMC #BikerGangs

recentItems.title: Inside the UK’s Most Extreme Underground Fight Club | Heavy Weekend
recentItems.description:
⚐ "Heavy Weekend" is a collaborative mini-series made by Away Days and VICE ⚐

Underground “no rules” fight clubs are spreading rapidly across Europe. They’re organised in secret, away from the eyes of the authorities. Locations are kept hidden and you can’t buy tickets to spectate.
  
Understand that no rules is not bare-knuckle boxing. It’s a lot more extreme. Fighters are allowed to gouge eyes and bite off ears. Stamping, head-butting, choking—it’s all allowed. This is not sport, it’s organised ultraviolence.

@AwayDaysTV journalist @Jake_Hanrahan attended Urban Gladiators, one of the first no rules fight clubs in the UK. There we found out why young men are risking it all on the concrete of the no rules underground.

recentItems.title: The Rise Of Gooning: Inside The World Of The Gooner Subculture
recentItems.description:
VICE explores the rise of the Gooning subculture: Over the last 18 months, the internet has hurled a new type of subculture into the world, one based around onanism,  self-pleasure—whatever you want to call it—and the people who are doing it for hours and hours on end in pursuit of a near-mythical zen-like state of bliss. These are the gooners, and they have been getting louder and prouder as media attention in their porn-obsessed pursuits has boomed.

But is gooning really a bona fide subculture, with its own slang, lore, and social codes? Or is it just an internet joke that got out of hand? Making her VICE debut, host Noelle Perdue heads to AVN—the world’s largest porn expo—for the first time since gooning exploded into the mainstream, to meet gooners, to listen to their fantasies and anxieties, and to try to get to the bottom of what gooning really is.

This documentary premiered at VICE: Members Only. See our best new documentaries first by subscribing: http://bit.ly/Subscribe-to-VICEVICE

recentItems.title: The Mayhem of Jason Miller | Dark Side Of The Cage
recentItems.description:
The rise, fall and recovery of former UFC fighter Jason “Mayhem” Miller. This Dark Side of the Cage premiere explores his MMA career, Bully Beatdown fame, battles outside the cage and path to sobriety. 

Jason “Mayhem” Miller was one of MMA’s most unpredictable fighters—a gifted showman who crossed from the cage into mainstream television as the host of MTV’s Bully Beatdown.

In the premiere episode of Dark Side of the Cage, Miller and those closest to him trace his journey from a rebellious childhood and early MMA success to fights with Georges St-Pierre and Michael Bisping, the infamous Strikeforce brawl, and a rapid rise to celebrity. They also confront the addiction, mental-health crises, arrests and incarceration that followed—and the hard road toward sobriety, reconciliation and a new life as a coach, mentor and family man.

Featuring Jason “Mayhem” Miller, Georges St-Pierre, Randy Couture, “Big” John McCarthy, TJay Thompson and members of Miller’s family.

About Dark Side of the Cage:
Back for its second season, Dark Side of the Cage cuts through the glamour and glory of the MMA spectacle to reveal the never-before-told stories behind its most iconic competitors and delves into the controversial and infamous events along the path to the sport's dominance.
